Brynna is a novice of the Absolute. She is searching the Wilderness for survivors of the Nautiloid Wreck alongside her fellow believers  Edowin and  Andrick.
“
You're a True Soul. You can't die. Please stay with us.
„
— Brynna, to Edowin

Involvement

Act One

Brynna can be found in the Forest at X: 139 Y: 446 worrying over her brother,  Edowin, who is dying from the wounds sustained from an Owlbear attack. She is more suspicious than her brother,  Andrick, should the party try to help.


Brynna has been tasked with looking for survivors of the Nautiloid Wreck. If the interacting party member reveals that they are those survivors, or are not followers of the Absolute, she and her brother become hostile. If they pass a Skill Check involving Medicine or Illithid Persuasion, Brynna and her brother do not attack:

  • [GOOD PALADIN] [GOOD CLERIC] He's wounded. I'd like to help - if you'll let me.
  • [MEDICINE] His wounds look deep. I might be able to help. (DC 10)
  • [TRUE SOUL] I will go where I wish.
  • [ILLITHID] [WISDOM] I will go where I wish. (DC 10)
  • Don't you recognise a True Soul when you see one?

If the interacting party member does not reveal their true allegiance, the siblings ask what they should do next. They can be convinced to continue searching for the survivors, to leave for the Goblin Camp, or to seek out the owlbear that attacked them. If they are told to seek out the owlbear, they head towards the cave where it can be found and go in. Inside, they hesitate before reaching the den, and the party can convince them to press forward:

  • [ILLITHID] [WISDOM] You have no choice. Go. (DC 5)
  • [TRUE SOUL] [ILLITHID] Move forward. Your True Soul commands it.
  • [TRUE SOUL] [ILLITHID] Move forward. I command it.
  • [PERFORMANCE] The Absolute has plans for you, child - and they only begin here. (DC 5)
  • [INTIMIDATION] I won't tolerate cowardice. Attack - now. (DC 10)
  • [NATURE] Press your advantage now, before the beast smells your fear. (DC 5)
  • [BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION] It killed your brother. FORGET FEAR. CHOOSE FURY. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Be sure. Attack. (DC 10 )

As long as the situation is resolved peacefully, the party are rewarded 70 Experience. Brynna can be a useful ally against the owlbear, and if she survives she can be told alongside Andrick to continue their search for survivors of the Nautiloid or return to the Goblin Camp.

In the Goblin Camp, Brynna informs the party they have not yet found the weapon they are searching for, and comments on her unusual allies. She turns hostile with the rest of the camp if a party member attacks the leaders in the Shattered Sanctum, before or after the raid on the Emerald Grove.

Killing both Brynna and Andrick gains ⁠Reuniting Friends for the  Dark Urge.

Brynna and Andrick's survival is not necessary for the recruitment of the Owlbear Cub; as long as its mother is dead, it appears at the Goblin Camp following the next Long Rest.

Companion approval

When meeting Brynna and Andrick over the dying Edowin in the Forest:

  • I'm a survivor of that crash. Looks like you found me.  +1
  • You need to find the beast and avenge your brother.  +1  +1
  • Forget the owlbear. You're still alive - so go.  +1
  • The beast is already dead. You should go.  +1
  • I killed an owlbear nearby. If that's what attacked your brother, consider him avenged.  +1

Speak with Dead

Brynna can be communed with using  Speak with Dead.

  • Who are you?
    • Brynna
      Brynna... a faithful... servant to... the Absolute...
  • What were you doing in the forest?
    • Brynna
      Serving... the Absolute... following... Her True Souls...
  • How did you die?
    • Brynna
      Serving... the Absolute... following... Her True Souls...
  • Tell me about the Absolute.
    • Brynna
      Out leader... our goddess... our future... bow to her... or die...
  • What is a 'True Soul'?
    • Brynna
      The Absolute's... chosen few... my brother... they hear... Her words...
